idea-plugin.name: Lavender Mist Theme
idea-plugin.description:
A light theme family for JetBrains IDEs: a soft lavender frame, cool white panels and deep purple accents, inspired by the classic Visual Studio Blue theme that Visual Studio 2026 no longer ships.

  • Lavender Mist Gold: Blue's gold active tab.
  • Lavender Mist Indigo: a lavender selected tab with purple text and outline.
  • Lavender Mist Blue: Blue's periwinkle selection.

Two editor schemes: Lavender Mist, with Visual Studio's C# colours deepened to reach at least 4.5:1 contrast, and Lavender Mist Purple, with purple keywords. Every text colour is checked for contrast when the theme is built.

Requires JetBrains IDEs 2026.2 or later with the Islands UI.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by Microsoft or JetBrains. Visual Studio is a trademark of Microsoft Corporation; Rider is a trademark of JetBrains s.r.o.

Shared semantic colours for C#, Java, Kotlin, Go and Python, with this theme's own palette and clearly separated panels.
